verdict.rationale: The only route to controlled rollout is implied: teams can check skills into the repo under `.agents/skills`, which Codex scans, and tooling can install skills as copied local folders, so skill changes travel through git commits rather than silent updates. There is no documented version pinning or lockfile for plugins or marketplaces, and published plugins' MCP server changes are picked up automatically and go live after automated checks, which is the behind-the-back update the story wants to avoid. missing for 10: plugin/skill version pinning, a lockfile mechanism, admin control over when marketplace or MCP updates reach the team, independent corroboration.
